mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates and boosts valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% signals economic distress and triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors reduce equity exposure.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) combined with accommodative policy (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) signals stagflation risk, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets price in deteriorating growth-inflation dynamics.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235 and FEDFUNDS < 1.0% over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, strong housing starts above 950 thousand units signal economic overheating and prompt central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 950 thousand units over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 102 (2017=100) indicates weakening economic activity, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 102 over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales above 440,000 million dollars signal strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 440000 over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) signals central bank commitment to combat inflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as rate hikes pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: In the monetary tightening cycle regime, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235 over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts above 950 thousand units combined with robust retail sales above 440,000 million dollars indicates a synchronized consumer and housing boom, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 950 and RSAFS > 440000 over the next 12 months.
